title: Accelerator
paragraphs: “Well… I guess that’s okay.”
“You’ll need to get strong enough to do Class Up, won’t you?”
“…Class Up?”

Oh? So Father didn’t even know about that back then. …I can’t help but feel a genuine sense of admiration. After all, he groped his way forward without knowing anything, cleared his name through his own efforts, and led the world to peace just like that. I’ll do anything for Father.
“That’s right. ‘Class Up’ is a restriction that applies once to anyone other than the Hero at Level 40. Using the Dragon Hourglass to perform a Class Up unlocks that cap.”
“So there are some annoying mechanics in this world, huh… I see. Is that why you guys were all gathered around the Dragon Hourglass back then?”
“That’s right.”

Even if it’s knowledge that’ll become useless later on, a month should be enough time to handle something as simple as a Class Up. In fact, back then, I went there to help those Crimson Swine with their Class Up.
“So, since I was active in Melromarc, I won’t be allowed to do a Class Up, right?”
“I heard it was because of that Trash that you couldn’t do it, of course.”
“Ugh… So, can I do it here in Zeltoble?”

“A Hero might be able to do it, but Zeltoble is a place that values merit above all else. I’ve heard you’ll get permission if you make a name for yourself as a merchant and pile up the money, or if you make a name for yourself as a mercenary in the Colosseum.”
“What about Siltvelt?”
“It’s a free pass, of course. The problem is, if you don’t make sure to smooth things over behind the scenes, you’ll end up in the castle.”
“Every single one of them is such a pain in the ass…”

Father ran his fingers through his hair and looked out at the streets of Zeltoble with an exasperated expression. As you say, the people in this world are all about their own self-interest. There are few who fight for peace, loyalty, and love like I do.
“Well… as long as I keep quiet, no one will know I’m the Shield Hero, so it might be easier to operate here than in Melromarc.”
The two key points are business acumen and strength. In this country, your character can be worked out later.
“So? Motoyasu, can we start hunting right away?”
“Of course!”
“Well then, let’s get started… I’d rather not rely on you too much, but I guess we’ll give it a try.”
“So, shall we hunt in the sea or the mountains?”
“Underwater combat right off the bat is a bit much…”

It’s true that Father-in-laws probably don’t have any experience with underwater combat at this point. However, based on what I know, they should have relatively extensive EXP in the ocean. After all, that desert machine should still be operational. If Older Sister were here, the ocean would be a breeze, but I can’t rely on someone who isn’t here. Still…
“Since my Older Sister is from a fishing village, wouldn’t the ocean be easier?”
“Well, it’s true that the ocean was close by, so I can swim, and I don’t get seasick.”
“Is seasickness different from getting sick in a carriage?”
“The way they sway is different.”
“Is that so…?”
I’m not really sure about that. I’m sure Filolial’s motion is a “noble” kind of motion sickness, while seasickness is a “natural” kind.
“Still, we’ve got Filo with us, and our gear would rust out at sea. The mountains are fine for now, right?”

Father-in-law and the others had been steadily building up their gear, hadn’t they? I believe the fact that Filo-chan was pulling a handcart was a preliminary step before they eventually switched to a carriage to travel around Melromarc as peddlers. So, to put it mildly, Fathers’ current gear isn’t exactly top-notch.
However! Now that I, Motoyasu, have arrived from the future, we can bid farewell to such inconvenient circumstances.
“Well then, let me show you the way.”
“Gua!”

At that moment, Filo-chan let out a cry from behind Father, as if to assert herself. As always, it’s a beautiful, resonant voice. I could listen to it forever. Ah, being able to spend time with Filo-chan… this alone makes it different from the previous loop!
“Oh, Filo-tan, so you want to show Father and the others around, do you?”
Filo-tan isn’t responding to my question. I wonder why?
“It’ll be… difficult for the three of us to ride on Filo. We’ll have to find a cart or something somewhere.”
“A horse-drawn carriage would be best!　It’ll be a present for Filo-tan!”
“We don’t have that kind of money! You left your money in Riyute Village as reconstruction funds, didn’t you?”
“Hahaha, I’m not talking about that kind of pocket change—I’m going to order a magnificent carriage that’ll cost a fortune!”
“Gua! Gua-gua!”
Oh! Filo-chan’s eyes are sparkling at the thought of possibly getting a fancy carriage. Filo-chan, just leave it to this Motoyasu. I’ll definitely get you a magnificent carriage!
“Um… if possible, I’d rather not ride in one.”
“You’ve got to get used to motion sickness, or you’ll be in trouble when it really counts, you know? ”
“I-I suppose so…”
“Oh well… Rafhtalia and I will ride on Filo, so Motoyasu, you run and keep up.”
“That’s ridiculous…”
“Got it!”
I nodded before Big Sister could try to warn Father about something. At Filo-chan’s current speed, keeping up will be a breeze.
“Ehh…”
“So there you have it. Let’s head out hunting right away.”
Father urged my older sister to climb onto Filo-chan’s back, so she reluctantly did so. Father is riding behind her, supporting her. It looks a little cramped for Filo-chan right now.
“Well then… right. First, let’s head out of town and ride in the direction I point. We’ll head back when it’s a good time at night, I suppose? Sleeping out in the open is fine, too.”
“We’ll decide that when the time comes.”
As expected of Father—he seems to be taking things as they come. Father gave Filo-tan a command. Then, Filo-tan began to walk.
“Yes, sir!”
“Gua!”
“Whoa!”
The main street of Zeltoble is crowded, so we can’t move very fast. Eventually, just as we left the town, Father gave Filo-tan a light tap on the rear.
“All right, let’s go!”
“Guaaaaaa!”
“GO!”
As if she’d been waiting for this moment, Filo-tan started running. I ran alongside her, heading toward the mountains with Father and the others.
“T-the scenery is changing at an incredible speed, yet the Spear Hero is running after us as if it’s the most natural thing in the world. It’s so eerie it’s scary, Naofumi-sama!”
“Don’t worry about it! If you let Motoyasu get to you now, you’ve already lost! Just think of him as having some kind of acceleration device!”
“What’s an acceleration device!?”

I haven’t done anything special. It’s all thanks to leveling up and improving my stats! You’ll be able to do it in no time, Father! That said, I’ve put in my own training, too. To play to my heart’s content with the Filolials and the others, I need both speed and stamina!
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Liberation Prominence X! Hahaha! Weak! Way too weak!”

Monsters in plain sight, monsters hiding, monsters I don’t even know are there—I’ll wipe them all out! I’m doing this right in front of Father and Filo-tan, after all! I’ll put even more effort into this hunt than usual!
“Motoyasu, calm down! How far does he plan to keep running!? Whoa!?”
“Gua!”
“Filo, don’t try to keep up with him! He’s not someone you should mess with!”
“Guaaaaaa!”
“HAHAHA! This is the Filolial Real Lord, yoOOOOOOO! Anyone who gets in my way is dead meat!”
“Aaaaaaah! U, u… N-Naofumi-sama…”
“Are you okay, Raphtalia!?”
“The ride’s rough… and on top of that, because Filo’s so hyped up racing against the Spear Hero… u…”

We arrived deep in the mountains fairly quickly and swiftly crushed the monsters in our path. That said, from Father’s perspective, these monsters are a bit on the strong side. Thanks to the supplies he has on hand, which have given him a decent boost, he seems to be keeping up, but Big Sister-in-law appears to be struggling to keep up and is getting flustered.
Filo-chan is running right up to me, as if trying to keep up. Ah, what a fun footrace between Filo-chan and Father and the others. It’s a dream-like moment!
After about an hour of such a wonderful hunt, Big Sister must have reached her limit—she fainted while being carried by Father. Right now, we’re camping deep in the mountains to take a break.
“Ugh… everything’s shaking… like we were hunting monsters at high speed… ugh.”
“Hmm… maybe it was too intense.”

Father, who never gets motion sickness even in this world, is tending to my older sister as she lies in bed. It looks like he’s mixing some herbs and giving them to her to drink. It’s a revival potion, I suppose. He said he found the recipe just a moment ago.
“Gua!”
Filo-chan is cheerfully kicking me over and over again. Ah, what a blessed joy! This is a moment of pure bliss…
“Filo, stop it. You don’t need to kick me anymore.”
“Guh?”
“Ah, Father, you’re being too harsh!”
“…It’ll be your reward, after all. Seriously… getting a kick out of being kicked? You’re quite the pervert.”
“Come on, Filo-chan! Kick me some more!”
I’ll grab Filo-chan in a big hug!
“Guaaaaaaaaaaa!?”
Filo-chan unleashed a flurry of kicks at me as I tried to pounce on her. Thank you, thank you so much!
“Guaa!”

After kicking me a whole lot, Filo-chan crouched down as if to hide behind Father’s shadow and kept glancing over at me repeatedly. Does this mean she’s interested in me? It’s okay if I do more, you know?
“Got it? You’d better not get too involved with him. He’s a pervert, after all.”
“Gah.”
“That’s hurtful! I, Motoyasu! For Filo-chan and Father, I’d walk through fire and water. No matter the situation, I’ll never give up!”
“Sigh… That’s exactly why Raphtalia’s all groggy!”
Father let out a deep sigh. Well, that can’t be helped. After all, I’m going to be living with Filo-tan and the Filolials. I’ll just have to get used to it.
“So, Father, what are Filo-tan and her Older Sister’s levels like?”
“Ah, they’ve only been hunting for about an hour, but they’re leveling up at an astonishing rate. They’ve gone up five levels in just one hour.”
“That’s not as fast as I expected. What was Big Sister’s level before we left?”
“She went from Level 27 to 32. Filo’s already at 23…”
Hmm, they really aren’t leveling up as fast as I thought they would. I’d like to get them to the first level cap of 40 in a few hours, but given Big Sister’s condition, that might be difficult.
“I wonder what my month was all about…”

Father seems to be feeling a bit melancholy. Unlike the trash like me, Ren, and Itsuki, his month was a wonderful time that shone like the sun. Sure, the EXP and level gains might be small. But the intensity is on a whole different level.
“Hmm… Is this about right for an hour? By nightfall, we’ll get her to Level 40, and then Father will cast an ‘Aptitude Enhancement’ buff to level her up over and over again.”
“Ugh…”
“The hellish grind to get stronger has only just begun.”
“Na-Naofumi-sama, please help me…”
My older sister reached out her hand, her consciousness hazy. Is she going to be okay?
“Raphtalia, I understand how you feel. But now is the time to endure. By overcoming this trial, you’ll grow stronger and be able to ride out the waves.”
“Waves… O-okay.”

That’s my Older Sister for you. I don’t know exactly what she’s struggling with, but she’s not running away from what she finds unpleasant—instead, she’s prioritizing preparing for the battle against the waves. Just like Father, it’s people like them who were able to protect the world from the Crimson Swine itself. I can’t let them outdo me! For now, let’s just do what we can.
“Father! More importantly, let’s check the loot! You never know—we might get some good gear!”
“Sigh…”

We continued hunting for a few hours after that, and it seems Filo-tan and Big Sister grew noticeably stronger thanks to the enhancements Father applied! We got a decent number of weapon and armor drops, so we were able to upgrade Father-in-law’s gear. However, it seemed like Father-in-law was particularly attached to his favorite set of armor.

As the sun set, we returned to Zeltoble and checked into an inn. As usual, Big Sister-in-law was groaning as if she felt sick. But if my memory serves me right, Big Sister should have a high tolerance for alcohol. I’m certain of this because she used to travel with Father as a merchant. I suppose she must have gotten used to it after experiencing Filo-chan’s noble sway.
“I kept tossing the loot into my shield without dismantling them much, just to get the drops…”

In front of the small shed attached to the inn, Father was checking today’s haul. After all, I’d defeated quite a few monsters, and they take up a lot of space. When I asked him whether we should get a cart to transport them, he said he wanted to prioritize the drops this time, so we didn’t dismember them.
“How did it go?”
“…Raphtalia and Filo’s levels certainly went up quite a bit, and we’ve managed to gather a surprisingly good set of gear.”
Father muttered this while scratching his cheek, as if deep in thought.
“Should we sell off the extra weapons and armor?”
“You may dispose of them as you see fit, Father.”
I’ve managed to gather a decent set of gear myself, so it shouldn’t be a problem. In fact, turning them into cash to buy necessary items is the best course of action.
